name: High-resolution and coarse-grained rising thermal bubble simulations (LEX / CM1)
resolution: 100 m horizontal and vertical, 5 s time step (Truth); coarse-grained to 600 m horizontal, 300 m vertical, 15 s time step; domain 24 km x 24 km x 12 km
access: Related data used in this study to produce the figures can be accessed from Zenodo under https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.15730773 (Zhu et al., 2025b). The data and scaling parameters used for model training are provided on Zenodo under https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.18411485 (Zhu et al., 2026).
